verdict.rationale: Codex documents running tasks in isolated cloud environments and a local CLI sandbox whose writable roots you can inspect and bound, so this is real sandbox isolation rather than a dry-run. The docs are one-line claims, though, and never explicitly say production data or credentials are kept out of reach. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandboxed runs are isolated from production data and secrets, details on network and data-access limits inside the sandbox, independent hands-on corroboration of the isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Run tasks in isolated cloud environments, work in parallel
